name: Jim McCollum
occupation: Carpenter since the 1980s; has been building custom log cabins since 1987. Also a published poet.
background: Father of Lance Cpl. Rylee McCollum, a 20-year-old Jackson Marine killed in the Aug. 26, 2021, suicide bombing at the Kabul airport during the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan. He told KHOL he had not been seeking office but decided to run after his son’s death and a homecoming parade for Rylee’s remains, and that local Republicans also encouraged him to file. He said he wanted to be a voice for the voiceless as his son had been in service.
